items:
Welcome to Southern Charm, a beautiful three-bedroom, two-and-a-half-bath home located in Inlet Beach, Florida. This inviting retreat sleeps eight guests comfortably and is both pet-friendly and snowbird-friendly, making it a perfect choice for families and long-term stays. Highlights include a large southern-style front porch, a spacious second-floor balcony, and a fully fenced backyard with a gas grill and furnished deck. With public beach access just a two-minute walk (0.2 miles) away and six adult bicycles included, this home is ideal for those looking to enjoy the best of coastal living.

The fully equipped kitchen has everything you need to prepare meals with ease. Whether you’re whipping up a quick snack before heading to the beach or cooking a full gourmet dinner for family and friends, the kitchen is designed to make mealtime simple and enjoyable. The open layout connecting the kitchen to the living and dining areas creates a welcoming space for gathering, while the convenient washer and dryer closet on the first floor adds to the home’s comfort.

Southern Charm features a thoughtful bedding arrangement. The primary bedroom includes a private ensuite bathroom and access to the second-floor balcony, while the two additional bedrooms share a hall bathroom on the same floor. This setup provides both privacy and convenience, making it easy to accommodate families or groups traveling together.

Guests of Southern Charm can enjoy plenty of outdoor living space. Relax on the wide front porch, dine al fresco on the backyard deck, or fire up the grill for a cookout. With the added bonus of six adult bicycles, exploring the scenic surroundings becomes part of the fun.

When you’re ready to venture out, Inlet Beach offers endless opportunities for adventure. Spend the day browsing local shops, enjoying fresh dining, or heading out for fishing, golf, or watersports. Miles of walking and biking trails wind through the area, allowing you to experience the natural beauty of Florida’s Gulf Coast at your own pace.

Start planning your getaway today, book your stay at Southern Charm and create lasting memories in beautiful Inlet Beach, Florida!

responses.response: Thank you for sharing your feedback. We apologize for the inconvenience you experienced with the heater, microwave, and television during your stay. We understand how uncomfortable the first night must have been with cooler indoor temperatures, and we appreciate your patience as the weather improved the following day. Upon review we do show the issues with the microwave and the heater was reported to our 24/7 Guest Services Team and were advised these issues should be resolved after checkout, which was executed accordingly. We also regret the delay in follow up regarding the television and understand how disappointing that was, especially given the timing of the college playoffs. We are delighted that you found the home clean and enjoyed the location. Your input regarding the amenities has been shared with our Operations Team for review. Your feedback is invaluable as this helps to enhance the guest experience and hope to have the opportunity to host you again in the future.

reviews.text: The heater would not work at the property and the first night it was 58 in the house.It did warm up the next day and it became not such a issue but it was a day later when they called us back to come take a look at it. The microwave did not work also.We called to get someone to help with the TV where we could watch the collage playoffs and it was 2 days later when they called us back about that.Sooo it is a good area and the house is clean but the ammenities need work.

reviews.author: Ben P.
reviews.label: Terrible
reviews.text: I’d give this place zero stars if I could. We were hit with a strong musty smell immediately, and upstairs the carpet literally crunched under our feet. The bathtub drain was covered in what looked like mold and rust, the shower splash guards fell off when touched, and a towel rack fell off the wall and nearly hit my daughter.The deeper we looked, the worse it got: stains everywhere, ripped couches, scuffed walls and cabinets, and cracked toilet handles (one wrapped in masking tape instead of being replaced). It feels like basic maintenance just doesn’t happen here.Amenities were equally disappointing. None of the TV remotes worked (only Netflix worked during March Madness), and despite marketing itself as family-friendly, there were no games, beach gear, or activities. We were told there was no Pack-N-Play, only to find one there after paying 75 to fly with ours. There was also no carbon monoxide detector.The worst issue was the heater. A Dec 2025 review said it didn’t work, and it still doesn’t. Our kids woke up freezing the first night (57 inside set to 77). We were told it was fixed — it wasn’t. Later it was locked at 95, making the place smell like rotten eggs and turning bedrooms into saunas. We had to choose between freezing or overheating.This is an expensive property pretending to be charming and family-friendly. It isn’t. Only upside is beach proximity (across a busy highway).Stay somewhere else.
